name: Porters
overview: Scripture describes porters as dedicated Levites appointed to guard and oversee key entrances, including the city gates, the king's palace, and the temple doors. According to 1 Chronicles 9, these porters, organized in companies and led by chiefs such as Shallum, were entrusted with the sacred responsibility of maintaining the entry points of the tabernacle and temple, ensuring order and reverence in the house of the LORD. Their service was carefully structured, with 212 chosen by genealogical records and ordained by David and Samuel, highlighting the importance of faithful stewardship in God's worship.
